interpretation: Frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features provide a steep data-efficiency gain: test macro-F1 rises from 0.7193 at 1% to 0.8789 at 5%, 0.9438 at 25%, and 0.9602 at 50%; the 50%-to-100% gain is 0.0066. This is an in-domain random-split diagnostic for frozen features, not evidence of field data efficiency.
next_gate: model-family/computational benchmark or statistical multi-seed validation
